objective: Create the first direct-refresh route skeleton with route-group ownership for the gateway, Systems, Studio, and private admin entry points.

criteria.promise: The six launch entry paths render distinct semantic headings from direct route components.
The route skeleton uses the approved gateway, Systems, Studio, and admin ownership boundaries without creating a second application.
The private admin entry point is marked noindex and the public skeleton contains no prices or fabricated proof.
Focused route tests prove the six entry components render and the existing foundation gates remain green.

verification_gates.procedure: From starter, read the six route page files and run npm test; inspect the rendered component headings in tests/routes.test.tsx.
verification_gates.expected: The root, Systems, Studio, About, Contact, and admin paths each have one named semantic h1 and the route test passes.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect the relative paths under app/ and run npm run build to enumerate the App Router routes.
verification_gates.expected: Route groups are used for gateway, Systems, and Studio ownership, one app remains in use, and the build lists the six intended entry paths.

verification_gates.procedure: Read app/admin/page.tsx and search all changed route files for price, testimonial, award, stock, or guaranteed-result language.
verification_gates.expected: Admin metadata has robots noindex and no changed route file introduces prohibited public claims.

verification_gates.procedure: From starter, run npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd run typecheck; npm.cmd test; npm.cmd run build; npm.cmd run cf:build.
verification_gates.expected: All five commands exit 0 with the focused route tests passing and no lint warnings.

first_checkpoint.evidence: First coherent route-group page set plus a focused route-test scaffold covering the entry paths.
